tasks.label: validate: full CI quality gate
tasks.command: python3 -m py_compile server.py && python3 -c "from html.parser import HTMLParser; [HTMLParser().feed(open(f, encoding='utf-8').read()) for f in ('index.html', 'spec.html')]; print('HTML OK')" && python3 -c "import json; json.load(open('manifest.webmanifest', encoding='utf-8')); print('Manifest OK')" && python3 -c "import glob, xml.etree.ElementTree as ET; [ET.parse(f) for f in ['icon.svg'] + glob.glob('assets/*.svg')]; print('SVGs OK')" && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v

tasks.label: git: enable pre-commit hook
tasks.command: git config core.hooksPath .githooks && chmod +x .githooks/pre-commit && echo 'Pre-commit hook enabled (.githooks/pre-commit)'

tasks.label: github: check release & workflow status
tasks.command: gh release list && echo '--- Recent Workflow Runs ---' && gh run list -L 6 && echo '--- GitHub Pages Status ---' && gh api repos/RajwanYair/SchoolMeritPoints/pages --jq '{status: .status, url: .html_url, build_type: .build_type}'
